title: Kozmos 1
author: Büşra Yılmaz
description: Neva College, with its grand architecture, long-standing legacy, and high walls con-cealing deep secrets, has managed to preserve its prestigious reputation over the years. For outsiders, it has always been a fascinating world of allure, while within its walls, an invisible order operates; a game known only to the chosen few. With the start of a new school year, a mysterious app called KAOS disrupts the balance, pushing Neva College to the brink of irreversible chaos and exposing long-hid-den secrets. Cosmos is a unique novel experience, a “Cinenovel,” where the story unfolds like a visual TV series. Readers follow the characters’ moods, conflicts, and scenes as if guided by a camera.
